data: Apple's net income fell from $99,803 million in fiscal 2022 (year ended September 24, 2022) to $93,736 million in fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024), a decline of $6,067 million. That works out to a decrease of about 6.1% over the two-year period. The drop came despite fiscal 2024 net sales of $391,035 million being only slightly below the $394,328 million reported for fiscal 2022, and it reflects in part a higher provision for income taxes of $29,749 million in fiscal 2024 versus $19,300 million in fiscal 2022.
